lead: Aliko Dangote broke ground on a $16 billion refinery in Kenya alongside President William Ruto and former President Olusegun Obasanjo. The government declared 1 October a public holiday for the 66th Independence anniversary, and President Tinubu signed the bill extending the 2025 budget to December. Defence Headquarters said troops killed 554 terrorists and rescued 1,736 hostages in the third quarter, three people died in a stampede at Niger State Government House over a reported N10,000 handout, and 29 Nigerian universities entered the 2027 Times Higher Education rankings.

items.h: Dangote breaks ground on $16bn refinery in Kenya
items.s: Aliko Dangote began construction of the Lamu refinery with President William Ruto and Olusegun Obasanjo present. Honeywell will supply engineering, licensing and equipment for the 700,000-barrel-a-day plant.

items.h: 1 October declared public holiday; Tinubu to address the nation
items.s: Interior Minister Olubunmi Tunji-Ojo announced the holiday for the 66th Independence anniversary.

items.h: Tinubu signs extension of 2025 budget to December
items.s: The Appropriation (Amendment) (No. 4) Act moves the deadline from 30 September to 31 December 2026.

items.h: Military says 554 terrorists killed and 1,736 hostages freed in third quarter
items.s: Defence Headquarters said troops also arrested 1,333 suspects in three months.

items.h: Three die in stampede at Niger Government House over N10,000 handout
items.s: A crowd gathered after reports that money would be distributed; Atiku Abubakar said no Nigerian should die seeking N10,000.

items.h: 29 Nigerian universities in THE 2027 rankings
items.s: The number rose from 24 last year, with Covenant University, the University of Ibadan and UNILAG among the leaders.

items.h: Fake council chief Adeyemi remanded in Kuje
items.s: A Federal High Court in Abuja ordered the self-styled PFIPC director-general held at Kuje Correctional Centre.

items.h: Police defend arrest of men in #TinubuMustGo T-shirts
items.s: Borno police said the five men arrested in Maiduguri had drugs on them; Amnesty International rejected the claim and demanded their release.

items.h: Wike vows to resign if Tinubu loses FCT and Rivers
items.s: The FCT minister made the pledge on Wednesday.

items.h: Pantami confirmed Gombe PDP governorship candidate
items.s: He won the rescheduled primary across 11 local governments.

items.h: Court voids Gombe APC House primary
items.s: The Federal High Court disqualified the winner of the Billiri/Balanga primary.

items.h: Oyo Assembly passes state police amendment
items.s: Lawmakers approved the Sixth Alteration Bill.

items.h: Tinubu sends research fund and medical college bills to Reps
items.s: He also transmitted the NDDC budget.

items.h: Chelle says AFCON hopes alive after Bissau defeat
items.s: The coach insisted the 3-0 loss is not the end.

items.h: Atiku repeats call to publish Nigeria-US health pact
items.s: Ghana rejected a similar deal, he said.

items.h: Ekiti APC and PDP launch joint drive for Tinubu
items.s: Governor Oyebanji and allies target 90 per cent of the state's votes.

items.h: Uzodimma expands media campaign; Shettima seeks northern support
items.s: The Imo governor scaled up grassroots publicity, and the Vice President asked northern creatives to back Tinubu.

items.h: FG plans 24-hour power Energy Zones
items.s: Talks began with distribution companies on dedicated zones in high-demand areas.

items.h: CBN says recapitalisation is a starting point
items.s: Banks must match capital with risk management and cybersecurity.

items.h: GTCO files audited half-year results
items.s: Profit before tax was N603 billion.

items.h: Wike's son submits US passport to court in land case
items.s: The FCT High Court adjourned to 1 December.

items.h: JAMB extends deadline for 2021-2025 admission offers
items.s: Candidates have until 30 November.

items.h: FCTA to complete Utako hospital and upgrade 14 others
items.s: Work resumes on the long-abandoned facility.

items.h: Kaduna rehabilitates 17 health centres
items.s: Tricycle ambulances were also distributed.

items.h: Kaduna BRT to start in early 2027
items.s: It could create up to 20,000 jobs.

items.h: Kano revives Goron Dutse reservoir
items.s: The facility returns after 30 years, adding 40 million litres.

items.h: Yobe pays N6bn to 4,271 council retirees
items.s: The SSG disclosed the payments.

items.h: NSCDC deploys to Ekiti flood areas
items.s: Officers went to communities hit by heavy rain.

items.h: Senate to hold two-day security summit
items.s: Barau Jibrin announced it.

items.h: Customs returns rescued gorilla to Congo
items.s: Bili spent three years in rehabilitation.

items.h: Retired justice warns judges against politicians' gifts
items.s: Ibrahim Saulawa said gifts threaten neutrality.

items.h: 26MW Akute plant to power Lagos Water
items.s: Fenchurch will rebuild it.

items.h: Morocco names first woman prime minister
items.s: Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri became the first woman to lead Morocco's government after her liberal-centrist party won the 23 September election.

items.h: Flydubai co-pilot allegedly stabbed pilot mid-flight
items.s: The plane made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia.
